title: A uniqueKeys that is not an array of 1 to 8 key pointers, no two equal, is refused at open with schema.invalid naming the keyword
notes: Each schema of package breaks the grammar one way: no pointer, nine, a member that is not a string, the empty pointer, a pointer with no leading slash, an escape RFC 6901 does not define, two equal pointers, and a string in place of the array, in a subschema. valid holds eight pointers, escaped ones and the pointer to the empty member name among them.
